# Renderer-level reference cases for RasterRenderer, rendered by
# matplotlib's RendererAgg (generate.py) and compared in
# tests/agg_backend.rs.
#
#   case <name> <width> <height> <dpi>
#   path <id> <M|L|Q|C|Z tokens> (display coordinates, y up, unless a
#        transform is given); `nan` is a valid coordinate
#   affine <id> a b c d e f        (matplotlib Affine2D.from_values)
#   <op> ... key=value ...
#   end
#
# Ops: draw_path <path>, draw_markers <marker> <positions>, collection,
# gouraud, image. Graphics-context keys: color, alpha, lw, cap, join,
# dashes=offset:l1,l2,..., aa, snap=auto|true|false, clip=x0,y0,x1,y1,
# clippath=<path> clipt=<affine>, hatch=<pattern> hcolor hlw,
# sketch=scale,length,randomness.

end
